o: Join Activities to Age on user_id, then per age bucket compute the share of total time spent on 'send' versus 'open', rounded to 2 decimals. E.g., bucket 31-35 has total 9.25 with 3.50 sent → 37.84% send, 62.16% open. Straightforward GROUP BY with conditional aggregation.
k: Conditional aggregation (SUM CASE) splits time by activity type inside one grouped query.

a.n: Approach 1: JOIN + GROUP BY with SUM(CASE)
a.i: One grouped query over the joined tables; each percentage is the type-specific sum divided by the bucket total times 100.
s: Join Activities with Age on user_id.
Compute send/open percentages with SUM(CASE ...) divided by SUM(time_spent), rounded to 2 decimals.

c.python:
SELECT a.age_bucket,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN act.activity_type = 'send' THEN act.time_spent ELSE 0 END) * 100 / SUM(act.time_spent), 2) AS send_perc,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN act.activity_type = 'open' THEN act.time_spent ELSE 0 END) * 100 / SUM(act.time_spent), 2) AS open_perc
FROM Activities act
JOIN Age a ON act.user_id = a.user_id
GROUP BY a.age_bucket;

a.t: O(rows log rows) — dominated by the join/group aggregation

a.i: Compute each bucket's total via a window function over partitioned rows, then filter per-row shares and aggregate — equivalent result, occasionally preferable when composing with other per-row logic.
s: Add SUM(time_spent) OVER (PARTITION BY age_bucket) as bucket total.
Divide per-type sums by that total and group.

c.python:
SELECT DISTINCT age_bucket,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_type='send' THEN time_spent ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY age_bucket) * 100 / total, 2) AS send_perc,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN activity_type='open' THEN time_spent ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY age_bucket) * 100 / total, 2) AS open_perc
FROM (
  SELECT act.*, a.age_bucket,
         SUM(act.time_spent) OVER (PARTITION BY a.age_bucket) AS total
  FROM Activities act JOIN Age a ON act.user_id = a.user_id
) t;
